decisions.reason: Its flame-retardant performance and clear fit with contract and hospitality applications keep it strategically important and commercially defensible.
Its niche decorative role and wool-blend construction make it a weaker fit with the portfolio and the firm's move away from harder-to-recycle blended materials.
Despite its specialized premium positioning, it still supports the firm's decorative identity and remains more compatible with the collection direction than other niche items.
As a recent launch with broad upholstery-and-curtain applicability and strong website prominence, it merits more time in the market.
